name: agency-event-os
description: West Peek Live! virtual event production platform.

scripts.postdeploy:full: npm run postdeploy:smoke && npm run postdeploy:click-audit && npm run postdeploy:role-flow && npm run postdeploy:video-provider && npm run postdeploy:browser
scripts.predeploy:hard: npm run sync:required-secrets && npm run validate && npm run validate:production-config && npm run audit:cloudflare-secrets

scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run validate:v5-hard && npm run validate:v7 && npm run validate:deploy-parity
scripts.validate:auth: npm run test -- --run tests/unit/authSession.test.ts tests/unit/accessResolver.test.ts tests/unit/authActions.test.ts
scripts.validate:backend-foundation: npm run test -- --run tests/unit/env.test.ts tests/unit/email.test.ts tests/unit/audit.test.ts
scripts.validate:daily-fallback: node scripts/validate_daily_fallback.js && npm run test -- --run tests/unit/dailyProvider.test.ts tests/unit/videoFallbackPolicy.test.ts tests/unit/testingConsole.test.ts
scripts.validate:deploy-parity: node scripts/validate_deploy_env_contract.js && node scripts/validate_smoke_test_freshness.js && node scripts/validate_frontdoor_runtime_graceful_degradation.js && node scripts/validate_cloudflare_required_secrets_manifest.js && node scripts/validate_click_audit_contract.js && node scripts/validate_speed_networking_e2e_contract.js && node scripts/validate_global_logo_and_stage_features.js && node scripts/validate_no_node_crypto_on_public_runtime.js && node scripts/validate_env_does_not_crash_access_gates.js && node scripts/validate_required_env_registry.js && node scripts/validate_production_config_policy.js && node scripts/validate_runtime_audit_contract.js && node scripts/validate_role_journey_e2e_contract.js && node scripts/validate_transactional_full_buffett_e2e_contract.js
scripts.validate:persistence: npm run test -- --run tests/unit/persistenceMapping.test.ts tests/unit/clientEventSchemas.test.ts tests/unit/coreReadModel.test.ts
scripts.validate:phase2d2e2f: npm run test -- --run tests/unit/speakerOps.test.ts tests/unit/sponsorOps.test.ts tests/unit/approvalOps.test.ts tests/unit/eventIntake.test.ts tests/unit/changeControl.test.ts tests/unit/networkingOps.test.ts
scripts.validate:production-ops-persistence: npm run test -- --run tests/unit/productionOpsSchemas.test.ts tests/unit/operationalMapping.test.ts tests/unit/productionOpsActions.test.ts
scripts.validate:v4: npm run validate:v4-front-door && npm run validate:v4-access && npm run validate:v4-event-config && npm run validate:v4-publishing
scripts.validate:v5-hard: npm run validate:structure && npm run validate:brand && npm run validate:whitelabel-video && npm run validate:daily-static && npm run validate:v5-access-security && npm run validate:v5-route-authorization && npm run validate:v5-no-secrets && npm run validate:v5-event-config-schema && npm run validate:v5-publishing && npm run validate:v5-runtime-boundaries
scripts.validate:v6: npm run validate:v6-hard && npm run validate:v6-strong-warnings && npm run validate:v6-warnings
scripts.validate:v7: npm run validate:v7-route-safety && npm run validate:v7-ux-brand-demo && npm run validate:v7-operator-launchpad && npm run validate:v7-frontdoor-labels && npm run validate:v7-day1-packet
